title: The Sept of Caribou Crossing
summary: A northern holy site with Uktena Bane Tenders.

claims.text: Caribou Crossing is a holy site of the Red Talons in the Canadian north, about two weeks’ run beyond Sky Pines; because of its dark past, a pack of Uktena Bane Tenders guards it alongside the Talons.

title: Sky Pines
summary: A Red Talon caern in Canada, as one novel tells it.

claims.text: The Tribe Novel Red Talons and Fianna tells that Sky Pines is a Red Talon caern in Canada, where the great moon howler Heard-by-Gaia is among the most honoured Garou.

title: Karin Jarlsdottir
summary: Leader of the Sept of the Anvil-Klaiven, as the novels tell it.

claims.text: The Tribe Novel Red Talons and Fianna tells that Karin Jarlsdottir, a homid Get of Fenris born under the half-moon, is a judge of real standing who is well thought of even among the Red Talons of Canada.

title: Cries Havoc
summary: A Child of Gaia who joined a Get sept, as one novel tells it.

claims.text: The Tribe Novel Red Talons and Fianna tells that Cries Havoc, a Child of Gaia envoy from the Sept of the Dawn, answered for the death of the Get warrior Arne Wyrmsbane by paying a symbolic life-price and then taking Arne's place in the Get sept.
